project.description: Board — the client-feature framework. A detachable subsystem that is a PEER to mcp-core (net-new code, zero hard dependency either way): delete board and core still compiles; delete core and board still compiles. Board is the home of in-game features (Chip), the event bus (Trace), the feature manager (Matrix), HUD (Panel) and keybinds (Pin), all under the PCB naming motif. Compiled to Java 8 bytecode (inherited release=8) so it runs in the same JVM as the Java-8 game. It references Minecraft classes via the 'client' module (provided) and finds mcp-core, when present, by reflection only — it imports no core class.
